frames.name: State / Public Catalog Brands Open
interactionNotes: Catalog trigger exposes aria-expanded and renders the brand mega menu.

frames.name: State / Public Catalog Type Hover
interactionNotes: Type catalog opens from hover/focus and shows category columns.

frames.name: State / Public Mobile Menu Open
interactionNotes: Mobile menu expands below the sticky header with nav, catalog, locale, and quote CTA.

frames.name: State / Product Image Modal Open
interactionNotes: Image dialog opens from a real gallery trigger and is portaled above the page.

frames.name: State / Product Selected Thumbnail
interactionNotes: Thumbnail button aria-pressed and visual selected bar update with active image.

frames.name: State / Product Specifications Tab
interactionNotes: Radix tab selected state changes content and tab treatment.

frames.name: State / Products Filters Expanded
interactionNotes: Advanced filter region expands from the filter trigger.

frames.name: State / Products Filter Select Open
interactionNotes: Radix select content renders above the filter panel without clipping.

frames.name: State / Contact Service Select Open
interactionNotes: Service select popover opens in the quote form.

frames.name: State / Contact Validation Errors
interactionNotes: Client validation errors display without submitting invalid lead data.

frames.name: State / Product Card Hover
interactionNotes: Card hover uses lift, border, shadow, and image motion treatment.

frames.name: State / Public Fixed Background Visible
interactionNotes: Public fixed background layer remains stable behind scrolled content.

frames.name: State / Admin Calendar Open
interactionNotes: Calendar trigger opens a real dialog popover with selected date and scheduled cells.

frames.name: State / Admin Calendar Selected Date
interactionNotes: Selecting 04 Jun updates chart, calendar state, rail metrics, and work link context.

frames.name: State / Admin Products Select Open
interactionNotes: Admin select trigger uses visible open state and portal layering.

frames.name: State / Admin Notifications Open
interactionNotes: Notification popover opens above the sticky header without clipping.

frames.name: State / Admin Publish Confirmation Modal
interactionNotes: Publish action opens real confirmation modal with backdrop and dialog semantics.

frames.name: State / Admin Rich Text Active Controls
interactionNotes: Bold, italic, and image buttons expose aria-pressed and active treatment.

frames.name: State / Admin Locale Tab Selected
interactionNotes: Editor locale tab changes selected visual state and context text.

frames.name: State / Admin AI Draft Accepted
interactionNotes: AI creates draft-only result; accepted state is explicit and still human-reviewed.

frames.name: State / Admin Media Selected File
interactionNotes: Media panel selected-file state updates visible feedback.

frames.name: State / Admin Fixed Background Visible
interactionNotes: Admin fixed background layer stays behind panels and sticky shell while scrolled.

frames.name: State / Admin Sidebar Collapsed
interactionNotes: Sidebar collapse uses aria-pressed and stable width transition.
